_about: Settings of the Collection Intelligence Agent (backend/agent). Planning choices of the municipality, not regulations or measured facts. Change 'version' whenever a value changes: every agent run records the version it used.

schedule._note: Local times. The agent plans the next day's collection for every sector with demand, and reviews the day's operations in the evening.

planning._default_window_h: Used when the collection cycle sets no window for the day.
planning._comfortable_below_pct: Demand below this share of the capacity bound: also try one vehicle fewer.

objective._note: Weights of the plan score (lower is better). Unserved demand and overtime dominate by design: coverage first, then the window, then cost.

risk._note: Rule-based risk of a plan until a risk model exists: time slack within the window and coverage.

replanning._note: Conditions that make the agent propose a new plan for an adopted day (today or tomorrow). Below these, the plan is left alone: replanning has an operational cost.
